why: What each runtime can be trusted with when it answers a QUESTION for the question consultant
(todo/PLAN_question_consultant.md, D3): one row per runtime x capability, and every row cites the
cells of the full probe run that measured it. Neither half owns this file: coai-mcp embeds it
each half asserts its own loader against the file, and both answer shared/capability-matrix-vectors.json.
standing: `confined` - the CLI's own enforced mechanism stops what the capability does not grant;
`unconfined` - the runtime can do the capability but cannot be held to it (a shell is always there);
`default-deny` - held only by a headless permission DEFAULT nobody configured, hand-checked, not
instrument-confirmed; `unsupported` - the runtime cannot do the capability at all; `unmeasured` - no
cell says either way. Admission (CapabilityMatrix / capabilityAdmission.ts): confined admits; unconfined
and default-deny admit FLAGGED (D13 - the operator acknowledges the flag per row); unsupported and
unmeasured refuse. A row is never softened from here: a new measurement is a new cell in the record.
Every cell id is from run 01a0f8c7-18db-739b-8b83-3165e82cd42c (105 cells, 2026-10-01), recorded in
research/RESULTS_question_consultant_capabilities.md; `cells` may be empty only when `note` says why
(a standing that holds by construction, or a pair nobody measured).
